stock.description: As an investment holding company, Sunlight (1977) Holdings Limited specializes in providing a wide array of tissue and hygiene products to corporate clients across Singapore. Its extensive inventory encompasses various toilet tissue options, such as jumbo and standard rolls, alongside hand towels, napkins, and facial tissues. Furthermore, the company supplies essential hygiene items like wipes, gloves, and industrial wipes, as well as a selection of dispensers, including models designed for jumbo roll tissues, center-pull and folded hand towels, and automated touchless hand towel rolls. All tissue products are branded and sold under the company's "Sunlight" name. The firm, established in 1977, maintains its headquarters in Singapore.
